agent_role_mapping.policy: Default-deny: any agent name not explicitly registered is UNKNOWN, never PRIMARY.

reason_codes.PRIMARY_QUALIFIED: Primary agent's claim qualifies under existing rules, unchanged.
reason_codes.PRIMARY_EXISTING_RULE_REJECTED: Reserved (unreachable at current integration point -- only already-eligibility-passing records reach qualification).
reason_codes.SECONDARY_NOT_INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE: Reserved for a future stricter independence check.
reason_codes.SECONDARY_NOT_TICKER_SPECIFIC: Secondary-only group failed the existing, reused _is_ticker_specific gate.
reason_codes.SECONDARY_DUPLICATE_OF_PRIMARY: Secondary member restates a fact already carried by a Primary member in the SAME Evidence Fact group -- ineligible, prevents double counting.
reason_codes.SECONDARY_CAUSALITY_UNPROVEN: Secondary-only, ticker-specific, but relation/assertion_status did not clear the strong-causal bar (relation=='activation' AND assertion_status=='asserted') -- conservative default.
reason_codes.SECONDARY_QUALIFIED_CAUSAL_EVIDENCE: Secondary-only, ticker-specific, AND cleared the strong-causal bar -- genuinely independent evidence, eligible.
reason_codes.UNKNOWN_SOURCE_ROLE: Agent name not in either registry -- default-deny, never eligible.

before_after_evidence_fact_counts.definition: unique_evidence_fact_count = number of canonical Evidence Fact groups (post-dedup) feeding EvidenceQuality/AgentIndependence/TickerSpecificity for one (ticker, alpha_id) pair. 'Before' = every group's members treated as eligible regardless of source role (pre-Step-6 behavior, computed via a no-op qualification passthrough over the SAME formula code -- not a separate reimplementation). 'After' = Step 6's role-based qualification applied.

before_after_activation_score_and_status.definition: activation_score/status computed by score_alpha_v2 with 'before' = no-op qualification passthrough (byte-identical pre-Step-6 formula path) vs 'after' = real qualification, both over the same persisted alpha_matches.json, graph_edges=() (these directories hold no structure_graph.json -- local_structure_support is not exercised by this comparison; comparison isolates the evidence-fact/agent-qualification effect on the other five components + caps/regime-gate).
before_after_activation_score_and_status.expected_direction: LOWER or equal activation where Secondary agents were inflating support -- confirmed below. This is intended, not a regression; thresholds/formula are unchanged.

b2_conflict_admissibility_impact.definition: detect_alpha_conflicts run per ticker over the real MVP-10 taxonomy's declared conflict pairs, 'before'/'after' via the same no-op-vs-real qualification technique (applied to both Activation's evidence gathering AND conflict_detector's own _qualify_and_filter_evidence, since B2 consumes activation_score + its own qualifying-claim pool). B2's own threshold VALUES (score>=50, >=2 unique supports_alpha facts, >=1 ticker-specific fact per side) are untouched -- see conflict_admissibility.ALPHA_SCORE_THRESHOLD/MIN_SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE_PER_SIDE/MIN_TICKER_SPECIFIC_SUPPORT_PER_SIDE, pinned unchanged by test_15 in tests/test_evidence_source_role_qualification.py.
b2_conflict_admissibility_impact.notable_finding: MSFT and SNDK: main_conflict was non-null before qualification (A101__A304 for both) and becomes null after -- every previously-admitted candidate pair on these two tickers relied on Secondary-agent-inflated evidence that no longer clears B2's unchanged >=2-unique-fact / ticker-specific bar on its own.

duplication_inflation_audit.definition: Evidence Fact groups where a Secondary member restates a fact already carried by a Primary member in the same group -- SECONDARY_DUPLICATE_OF_PRIMARY. The group itself was already deduped to 1 fact by the existing canonical grouping (evidence_fact_index.group_evidence_candidates) both before and after Step 6; what changes is that the Secondary member's AGENT no longer counts toward agent_independence/cross_agent_confirmation for that group.

Step 6 qualification can now make qualified evidence empty while raw direction evidence still exists (all of it Secondary/ineligible), which surfaced the bug via the components-sum-equals-activation-score invariant test. Fixed by gating direction_consistency the same way recency already was -- a minimal, correctness-only fix, not a formula/weight change.
